preconditions.description: The grid dimensions n and m must be between 1 and 1000, and k must be between 1 and the minimum of 40 or the product of n and m.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i][j] <= k for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: Each city color in the grid must be between 1 and k.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= q <= 100000 and all(1 <= r1 <= n and 1 <= c1 <= m and 1 <= r2 <= n and 1 <= c2 <= m for r1, c1, r2, c2 in missions)
preconditions.description: The number of missions q must be between 1 and 100,000, and each mission's coordinates must be valid within the grid.

postconditions.description: The output must be a space-separated string of minimum times for each mission.
Each minimum time must be non-negative.
At least one mission must have a minimum time of 0 if the starting and ending cities are the same.
